01 · Professional Profile

I am a dedicated and enthusiastic Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) student with practical exposure to primary classroom teaching. I am interested in activity-based learning, child-centred teaching, structured lesson planning and creating a supportive classroom environment where every learner can participate.

Through teaching practice and school-based experiences, I aim to strengthen my skills in classroom management, student engagement, assessment and the thoughtful use of teaching-learning materials.

07 · Teaching Reflection

My school-based teaching experience has helped me understand that effective teaching requires planning, patience, clear communication and attention to individual learning needs. I have learned the importance of connecting concepts with learners' everyday experiences, asking questions to check understanding and using activities to make classroom learning participatory.

As a future primary teacher, I will continue improving my subject knowledge, communication, inclusive teaching practices and reflective skills so that I can support the academic and overall development of children.
